verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component. Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a software or service privacy axis that buyers comparing processors would not reasonably evaluate. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip, or its bundled Ryzen Master tuning utility, collects telemetry or offers privacy controls, so the axis does not become applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
